intent.goal: Demonstrate a managed work-list pattern for bounded unknown work items.
acceptance_criteria: The graph validates against the current v1 contract.
The managed node plans, freezes, executes, verifies, and publishes stable work-list artifacts.
A downstream deterministic check verifies the stable work_items artifact.
constraints: Do not depend on dynamic item refs.

intent.goal: Inspect the repository docs and produce a bounded list of documentation quality observations.
acceptance_criteria: The work list is frozen before execution starts.
Every item has a completed evidence handoff.
The final handoff summarizes completed observations, validation evidence, risks, and downstream constraints.

context.name: docs_readme
context.why: The work-list planner needs a bounded source file for the showcase task.

work_list.planning_goal: Discover the ordered documentation observations needed to satisfy this showcase contract.

item_guidance.what_counts_as_one_item: One coherent documentation observation with its own evidence handoff.
done_when: The observation is grounded in the provided docs pointer.
The item handoff records result, evidence, risks, and downstream implications.

args: const fs=require('node:fs'); const path=require('node:path'); const input=process.env.AGENTFLOW_CONTEXT_WORK_ITEMS; const outputDir=process.env.AGENTFLOW_OUTPUT_DIR; const data=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(input,'utf8')); const items=Array.isArray(data.items)?data.items:[]; const passed=data.status==='completed' && items.length>0 && items.every((item,index)=>item && item.id===`w${index+1}` && item.status==='completed' && typeof item.summary==='string' && item.summary.trim().length>0); const result={passed,status:data.status,item_count:items.length}; if (outputDir) { fs.mkdirSync(outputDir,{recursive:true}); fs.writeFileSync(path.join(outputDir,'verification.json'), JSON.stringify(result,null,2)+'\n'); } console.log(JSON.stringify(result)); process.exit(passed?0:1);

intent.goal: Verify the managed work-list node published a stable completed work_items artifact.
acceptance_criteria: The artifact includes at least one sequential completed item with a summary.

context.name: work_items
context.what: Stable public work item index from the managed work-list node.
context.why: The deterministic check verifies the stable work item index is present and suitable for later review.

verification.description: Structured result for the work_items artifact verification.
